prompt: doxygen \image command inline option caption behavior HTML
answer:
With Doxygen’s `\image{inline}` option, the image is placed within the line. If a caption is provided, it is displayed in HTML as the image’s tooltip (`title` attribute), not below the image. The caption is ignored for other output formats.

Example:

```text
\image{inline} html image.png "Caption"
```

The syntax is `\image{inline}`, not `\image inline`.
